message.content:
Yes—if you’re experiencing excessive or disruptive noise in Atlanta, you can file a complaint with the city’s local authorities. Atlanta’s noise‑related issues are handled through the **City of Atlanta Police Department** and the **City of Atlanta Code Enforcement** office, both of which enforce the city’s noise ordinance. ### How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Step | What to Do | Where to Go | |------|------------|-------------| | **1. Gather Information** | • Date & time of the noise
• Exact location (address or intersection)
• Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs)
• Any evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings) | — | | **2. Contact the Police** | • Call 311 (non‑emergency) or 911 if it’s an emergency (e.g., ongoing violent activity).
• Provide the details you gathered. | 311 (non‑emergency) or 911 (emergency) | | **3. File a Code Enforcement Complaint** | • Use the City of Atlanta’s online portal to submit a “Noise Complaint.”
• You can also mail or drop off a written complaint at the City Hall. | Online portal: | | **4. Follow Up** | • Keep a record of your complaint number.
• If you don’t hear back within a reasonable time, call 311 again or visit the Code Enforcement office. | 311 or Code Enforcement office | ### Quick Links - **Atlanta 311 (Non‑Emergency Hotline)** – 311 (or 311 on the city’s website) - **Online Complaint Portal** – - **City of Atlanta Police Department** – - **City of Atlanta Code Enforcement** – ### Things to Keep in Mind - **Noise Ordinance**: Atlanta’s noise ordinance prohibits loud or disruptive noise during certain hours (typically 10 p.m.–6 a.m. on weekdays and 11 p.m.–6 a.m. on weekends). - **Enforcement**: The police may issue a warning or citation; code enforcement may issue a notice or fine. - **Documentation**: The more detailed your complaint, the easier it is for officials to investigate. - **Community Mediation**: For recurring disputes, the city offers mediation services that can help resolve the issue amicably. ### Bottom Line Yes, you can report a noise complaint to your local council (the City of Atlanta). Use the 311 hotline or the online portal to file your complaint, and the city’s police and code enforcement teams will handle the investigation and enforcement.
